violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant
violation_type.typical_finding: The cribs at the operation did not have a labeling system that had the child's name, or as an alternative, having a labeling system with a number on the crib and a number/infant assignment map available to match with it in the room.

finding_variants.text: The cribs at the operation did not have a labeling system that had the child's name, or as an alternative, having a labeling system with a number on the crib and a number/infant assignment map available to match with it in the room.
It was observed that all four cribs in the infant 1 room was not label with child's name.
One infant was observed sleeping in a crib that was not labeled with the child's name
Three of eight cribs were not labeled. This was corrected at inspection when labels were added.
I observed unlabeled cribs used for children enrolled.
During the monitoring inspection it was found that the operation did not have the children's names labeled on their cribs/pack n plays.
